Operations review

Follow the work. Find the friction.

Understand how work moves through the business before deciding what to change.

Three areas to review.

Discuss your priorities ↗
01

Map a real workflow.

+

Choose one recurring piece of work and trace it from request to completion. Include the people, information, and decisions involved. Start with what happens in practice rather than what the process is supposed to look like.

02

Inspect the handoffs.

+

Look for waiting, repeated questions, and unclear ownership. Ask the people doing the work where the process becomes difficult. Connect their observations with specific stages of the workflow.

03

Test a practical change.

+

Choose a manageable improvement and agree on what the team will observe. Review the effect before extending the change. Use what you learn to decide whether to refine, continue, or try another approach.
